name: agentic
description: runs a task to completion with an LLM and tools, live TUI showing turns and tool calls, security gates, interruptible state
input: a task string via --task, plus flags for max turns and auto-approve; or use chat subcommand for live TUI
output: the task result on stdout, or a json envelope with --json; the chat subcommand renders a live terminal interface

cost.detail: cost is whatever the configured llm-adapter provider charges, this module adds nothing
